name: SeaweedFS
tagline: S3 buckets, identities and policies for SeaweedFS. Policies applied only when they drift; never deletes.

features.title: Buckets, identities, policies
features.body: Idempotent provisioning of S3 buckets, IAM identities and bucket policies.

features.title: Versioning and lifecycle
features.body: Bucket versioning and object expiration rules.

features.title: Two phases
features.body: Identities are rendered into the s3.config SeaweedFS loads at boot, merged rather than overwritten; buckets and policies are applied once the cluster is healthy.

features.title: Policies from JSON files
features.body: Bucket policies are loaded from JSON files and applied only when they drift.

features.title: Dry run
features.body: Previews every mutation against live state.

features.title: Never destructive
features.body: Never deletes buckets, identities or policies that are not in the config.
